name: Context-Window Occupancy vs. Per-Token Separability — companion code, simulations and estimates
description: Companion package of a technical case study of nuFormer, the transaction foundation model of Braithwaite et al. (2025, arXiv:2507.23267). Closed-form model of a fixed token window (occupancy x per-token separability, with proofs), six pre-registered simulations (displacement replication; literal token-budget test with heterogeneous event cost; four follow-up families on the exponent of d, occupancy against rate weighting, event fusion and quotas), order-of-magnitude estimates of the training and serving infrastructure, a claims ledger and a SHA-256 provenance chain recomputed from disk. Illustrative orders of magnitude; not a replication of nuFormer.
